# Cars

Mean speed of the cars is `r mean(cars$speed)` mph.

## Scatter Plot

Distance and Speed seem linearly correlated.

```{r cars}
plot(cars$speed, cars$dist, ylab = "Distance", xlab = "Speed")
```

## Table

```{r table}
knitr::kable(cars)
```

## Analysis

This data set is very simple, only having speed and distance data. Such data can easily be plotted on a scatter plot. A weal linear correlation is noticeable.
